profile.dividendPolicy:
The Company's dividend policy is to pay dividend at a rate not less than 50% of the net profit shown in an annual separate financial statement after corporate income tax and all reserves specified by law since in each dividend payment, a part of net profit must be allocated as a legal reserve fund. However, the dividend payment depends on various factors, such as future investments, business expansion and other necessities and suitability in the future.
In addition, considering the dividend payment from the profit arising from the sale of investment or fixed assets that occurred in the Company or in subsidiaries, depending on the consideration of the management and the Board of Directors whether to pay dividends or not. Which will be considered from the investment and business expansion plans of the Company, including other necessities and suitability in the future.
